name: Brucellosis in small ruminants with an environmental reservoir and human cases
description:
Brucellosis, sheep/goats → humans, with Brucella in the environment.
The structural signature of this family is the additive direct + indirect force of infection with an explicit environmental bacterial compartment W, and the result that vaccination and disinfection of adults alone cannot eradicate because y
Parameter values: 0 of 17 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Hou Q, Sun X, Zhang J, Liu Y, Wang Y, Jin Z (2013). Modeling the transmission dynamics of sheep brucellosis in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China. Mathematical Biosciences 242(1):51–58

compartments.name: W
compartments.description: Brucella in the environment (bacterial load, arbitrary units)

parameters.name: mu_s
parameters.description: sheep removal rate (slaughter + natural death) [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: beta_ss
parameters.description: direct sheep-to-sheep transmission coefficient [illustrative] (per sheep per year)

parameters.name: beta_sw
parameters.description: indirect (environment-to-sheep) transmission coefficient [illustrative] (per unit load per year)

parameters.name: sigma_s
parameters.description: rate exposed sheep become infectious (≈6-month latency) [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: nu_s
parameters.description: sheep vaccination rate (control lever; S19/Rev-1) [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: wane_s
parameters.description: waning of sheep vaccine protection [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: shed
parameters.description: environmental shedding rate [illustrative] (load units per infectious sheep per year)

parameters.name: decay
parameters.description: natural decay of Brucella in the environment [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: disinf
parameters.description: additional removal of environmental load by disinfection (control lever) [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: beta_hs
parameters.description: sheep-to-human transmission coefficient (occupational contact) [illustrative] (per sheep per year)

parameters.name: beta_hw
parameters.description: environment-to-human transmission coefficient [illustrative] (per unit load per year)

parameters.name: sigma_h
parameters.description: rate exposed → acute human case (≈0.25 year onset) [verified as a published value for this quantity in the related literature] (per year)

parameters.name: chron
parameters.description: rate acute → chronic human infection [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: gamma_a
parameters.description: recovery rate from acute infection [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: gamma_c
parameters.description: recovery rate from chronic infection [illustrative] (per year)

parameters.name: mu_h
parameters.description: human natural death rate [verified as a published value in the related literature] (per year)

variables.name: R0s
variables.expr: (beta_ss + beta_sw * shed / (decay + disinf)) * As * sigma_s / (mu_s * (mu_s + sigma_s + nu_s) * (mu_s + shed * 0 + 1e-12) )

variables.name: CHh_rate
variables.description: rate of new cumulative reported human cases (integrate with cumsum for the cumulative count)
